## How the pieces fit together

::: {.diagram-note}
- **OASIS CLI and TUI** are where operators plan work, start and monitor runs, inspect results, and verify evidence.
- **Standalone CLI and MCP** offer the same checked assessment workflow to people at a terminal and to agents using typed tools.
- **Elephant** stores and moves the data those workflows use; it is not itself the review screen.
- **MAPLES** is the web application for organizing grading work and completing human review.
- **Wayfinder Rubric Studio** lives in MAPLES, while **Wayfinder Operator** lives in the CLI and TUI. They share a family name, but each is designed for its own setting.
:::

## About the recordings

These tours replay recorded screens; they do not connect visitors to live OASIS services. Each tour explains which fixture it uses, whether model calls were made during recording, and how the media was checked for privacy. None of the public tours contains real learner data.
